attempted.why: exited 1 before initialize: No Sonenta API key. Either run `sonenta login` (the server then reads your key from ~/.sonenta/credentials) or set SONENTA_API_KEY in your MCP client config (e.g. Claude Desktop's mcp.json `env`). SONENTA_TOKEN — and the legacy VERBUMIA_API_KEY / VERBUMIA_TOKEN — are also accepted.
